LanguageData.LP_BeholderLair.label: beholder lair
LanguageData.LP_BeholderLair.description: Deep in an underground cave, a beholder guards its collection.
LanguageData.LP_BeholderLair.arrivedLetter: This is a beholder lair. Don't stand right in front of it: in front of its central eye casting is impossible and shield belts fail. Knocking off eyestalks removes its ray types.
LanguageData.LP_EndlessTomb.label: Endless Tomb
LanguageData.LP_EndlessTomb.description: A demilich's tomb. Only its skull remains, yet it's more frightening than any living wizard.
LanguageData.LP_EndlessTomb.arrivedLetter: This is the Endless Tomb. The demilich lets out a soul-devouring howl every 60 seconds: bring a doctor, since those whose souls are torn must be tended within 30 seconds. Silver weapons deal ×2 damage.
